title: Bounded colimit relations present a presentable infinity category
statement:
Use the universes and coherent infinity categories of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and presentability, regular cardinals, $\kappa$-small diagrams and $\kappa$-compact objects as defined in [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Use the notation $P_R(A)$ for relative free cocompletion in [lem-coef-infinity-relative-colimit-completion]. Let $C$ be a presentable infinity category. There exist an infinite regular cardinal $\kappa\in\mathcal U$, a small infinity category $A$ admitting $\kappa$-small colimits, and a fully faithful functor $i:A\to C$ preserving those colimits, whose essential image is the subcategory of $\kappa$-compact objects of $C$. Every object of $C$ is a small $\kappa$-filtered colimit of objects in this image. Let $R$ be a small collection consisting of colimiting cocones in $A$ with $\kappa$-small bases, and containing a representative for every $\kappa$-small diagram in $A$, up to equivalence of diagrams and cocones. Then $i$ extends to a colimit-preserving equivalence $P_R(A)\simeq C$ over $A$. Equivalently, for every infinity category $Z$ admitting all small colimits, restriction along $i$ gives an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{colim}}(C,Z)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}_R(A,Z).$$
Here the right side is the full coherent functor category on functors sending every member of $R$ to a colimiting cocone, or equivalently preserving $\kappa$-small colimits of $A$. The equivalence includes natural transformations and higher simplices and is natural in $Z$. The target $Z$ need not be presentable. All smallness and colimit assertions are relative to the original universe $\mathcal U$.
